text:
alex_pm: Quick sync — we need a compact, copy-pasteable scoring + pass/fail checklist for DP recruitment. Target 7 partners across staggered waves.

renee_cs: Recruiter checklist should be 5 bullets max: use-case, qps/p95, data residency, willingness to share prompts, VPN/VPC need (Y/N).

omar_se: Technical intake must include: sandbox call with trace header, run our 250-request harness, and a simple KV-cache smoke. If harness not runnable, tag as 'SE help'.

li_research: Prioritization model idea: score ProductFit (0-5), VolumeSignal (0-5), ComplianceCost (0-5 inverted), ExperimentOffset (+1 if share prompts), StrategicValue (+1 for references). Require avg >= 3.4.

ops_jun: Fast-path ops checklist for low-friction partners: 1) creds + IP whitelist 2) replay harness passed 3) telemetry consent 4) legal: basic data purge agreement. Fast-path SLA = 48h.

alex_pm: Graduation criteria => Sandbox replay >=95%, traces + KV hits observed, partner eval set >=30 prompts, latency p95 within 1.3x baseline, integration time <=12 days, no unresolved critical security items.

renee_cs: Incentives: 8 weeks free credits OR $4k credit + 6 hours SE time + optional co-marketing. Keep legal terms short to avoid blocking.

omar_se: Scope guard: no model retraining or offline dataset ingestion during pilot. Runtime tweaks (quant/flags) allowed if parity check passes. Any >6h eng work flagged as billable.

li_research: Feedback cadence: wave1 weekly 30m + daily 5-min health for first 3 days; later waves biweekly. Add a 6-question exit survey (NPS, top blockers, perf vs expected, integration ease, top 3 feature asks, convert intent).

alex_pm: Actions: Renee -> recruiter copy + one-pager today. Omar -> harness + README by tomorrow. Li -> exit survey + eval dashboard template Thu. Ops_jun -> add fast-path to playbooks. I'll assemble a partner packet once items are in.

pm-bot: reminder: pilot-onboard planning meeting Fri 9:30am PT.

all: lgtm
